sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Our proposal
move.body: We can proceed at your price if the terms below work for you; please confirm.

move.text:
Hello,

Hi, that works for us! We can accept your terms and await your order. We can do the 1500 ppm at the 47.00 EUR price with zero chargebacks. To be clear, our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. The offer stays valid for 30 days. Let's get this moving, we are ready to start production.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
